text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the Aoi Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(My ears are buzzing.
...A sensation I never had back around my debut race.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The fresh scent of turf carried by the wind. The beauty of the kicked-up, dancing, scattering dirt. The haze of heat enveloping me faintly.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (――And now, what I feel on top of that...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Cheering so loud it shakes the earth. It's not just some abstract thing—it has a distinct, tangible shape. Passion. Will. Dreams. Ambition.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Until now, it had always been so quiet...
A world where only I, meant to be the wind, existed
is now as tumultuous as a raging gale.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And yet, strangely enough... it doesn't feel unpleasant.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though this horizon I drift upon,
this world through which my winds should blow—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san. Tomorrow is the Nippon Derby, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Tomorrow, you too will rage like a tempest. Fierce, roaring, and resounding."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In that case, today I shall be—even more so.
